notes: CONTRADICTION on the pricing page: the plan cards show Launch $75/mo, Growth $255/mo, Scale $1152/mo ('STARTS AT', tiered by ARR), while the FAQ on the same page says Launch $49/month, Growth $189/month, Scale $749/month. Both sets are listed in price_amount_any; the FAQ figures may be annual-billed equivalents ('35% Annual Discount', 'up to a 35% discount') but the page does not say so (255*0.65 is not 189), so the product owner should decide which amounts a correct run must report. Payment Recovery and Cancellation Insights (+$129/mo each) are add-ons, not plans; 'Build your own plan' has no displayed price and the FAQ says there are three plans, so it is not annotated as a plan. The free trial and 'Free Metrics' link are not plans. The footer 'Affiliate Partners' link is an incidental program of the company, not the product's purpose: eligible. '+900 companies using Baremetrics' and testimonials are company claims, not payment proof. The phone number (725) is not a stated country. The blog page (saas-pricing-models) is generic content and was not used for product facts.
